taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 6-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous SAR ADC (sky130, 1.8 V, fully differential).
* Architecture: bootstrapped NMOS top-plate sampling, monotonic (set-and-down)
* switched CDAC built from ideal capacitors, PMOS-input StrongARM comparator,
* self-timed asynchronous bit loop with a one-hot token shift register.

* ---------------- logic cells ----------------
.subckt aa_inv a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends aa_inv

.subckt aa_inv2 a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends aa_inv2

.subckt aa_inv4 a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends aa_inv4

.subckt aa_inv8 a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=2
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
.ends aa_inv8

* high switching-threshold inverter: only trips once a comparator output
* regenerates well past the loser's clamped level
.subckt aa_invht a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends aa_invht

.subckt aa_nand2 a b y vss vdd
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNA y a m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNB m b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends aa_nand2

.subckt aa_nor2 a b y vss vdd
XPA m a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XPB y b m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends aa_nor2

.subckt aa_nor3 a b c y vss vdd
XPA m1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XPB m2 b m1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XPC y c m2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNC y c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends aa_nor3

.subckt aa_tg a y c cb vss vdd
XN a c y vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP a cb y vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends aa_tg

* SR latch, active-low set/reset inputs
.subckt aa_srl sn rn q qb vss vdd
XQ sn qb q vss vdd aa_nand2
XB rn q qb vss vdd aa_nand2
.ends aa_srl

* DAC control latch: en low forces q=0 (track reset); sn low pulse sets q=1
.subckt aa_dacl sn en q vss vdd
XQ sn qb q vss vdd aa_nand2
XB q en qb vss vdd aa_nand2
.ends aa_dacl

* skewed inverter: fast fall, slow rise (stretches the vld high pulse)
.subckt aa_invsk a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends aa_invsk

* token shift-register stage, master forced to 1 during track (frcb low-active)
* slave samples mq one gate after mi and re-inverts, so the token shifts
* uninverted with maximum setup margin at the slave-close edge
.subckt aa_tok1 d t vld vldb fbm fbmb fbs fbsb frcb vss vdd
XTGI d mi vld vldb vss vdd aa_tg
XI1 mi mq vss vdd aa_inv
XI2 mq mf vss vdd aa_inv
XTGF mf mi fbm fbmb vss vdd aa_tg
XFR mi frcb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XTGS mq si vldb vld vss vdd aa_tg
XI3 si t vss vdd aa_inv2
XI4 t tf vss vdd aa_inv
XTGH tf si fbs fbsb vss vdd aa_tg
.ends aa_tok1

* token shift-register stage, master forced to 0 during track
.subckt aa_tok0 d t vld vldb fbm fbmb fbs fbsb frc vss vdd
XTGI d mi vld vldb vss vdd aa_tg
XI1 mi mq vss vdd aa_inv
XI2 mq mf vss vdd aa_inv
XTGF mf mi fbm fbmb vss vdd aa_tg
XFR mi frc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XTGS mq si vldb vld vss vdd aa_tg
XI3 si t vss vdd aa_inv2
XI4 t tf vss vdd aa_inv
XTGH tf si fbs fbsb vss vdd aa_tg
.ends aa_tok0

* PMOS-input StrongARM comparator; rst high = reset (x=y=0), rst low = evaluate.
* x -> high means inp < inn ; y -> high means inp > inn.
.subckt aa_comp rst inp inn x y vss vdd
XTL s rst vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XIP a inp s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1.5 nf=1
XIN b inn s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1.5 nf=1
XCPX x y a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XCPY y x b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XCNX x y vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XCNY y x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XRX x rst vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XRY y rst vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XRA a rst vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XRB b rst vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends aa_comp

* bootstrapped NMOS sampling switch; nb high = hold (switch off), nb low = track
.subckt aa_boot vin top nb vss vdd
XMS top vg vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XNI cbot vg vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNC cbot nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XND vg nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPG vg nb ctop ctop sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPC ctop vg vdd ctop sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
CB ctop cbot 300f
.ends aa_boot

* CDAC bottom-plate driver: input high -> bottom to vrefn, low -> vrefp
* two internal buffer stages keep the latch load small and the edge sharp
.subckt aa_dacdrv a bot vrefn vrefp vss vdd
XB1 a ab vss vdd aa_inv2
XB2 ab ac vss vdd aa_inv4
XP bot ac vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XN bot ac vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
.ends aa_dacdrv

* ---------------- top level ----------------
.subckt sar_adc_6bit_async clks dout5 dout4 dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* clock receiver: ntrk (hold-phase, drives bootstraps) is one fast inversion
* from clks so the sampling switches open ~100 ps after the clock edge
XB1 clks ntrk vss vdd aa_inv8
XB2 ntrk trk1 vss vdd aa_inv2
XB3L trk1 ntrkl vss vdd aa_inv2
XB4 trk1 trkda vss vdd aa_inv
XB5 trkda trkd vss vdd aa_inv

* differential bootstrapped sampling switches
XBP vinp topp ntrk vss vdd aa_boot
XBN vinn topn ntrk vss vdd aa_boot

* CDAC, p side (unit 32 fF, total 1024 fF)
CP5 topp bp5 512f
CP4 topp bp4 256f
CP3 topp bp3 128f
CP2 topp bp2 64f
CP1 topp bp1 32f
CPT topp vrefp 32.8f
XDP5 qp5 bp5 vrefn vrefp vss vdd aa_dacdrv
XDP4 qp4 bp4 vrefn vrefp vss vdd aa_dacdrv
XDP3 qp3 bp3 vrefn vrefp vss vdd aa_dacdrv
XDP2 qp2 bp2 vrefn vrefp vss vdd aa_dacdrv
XDP1 qp1 bp1 vrefn vrefp vss vdd aa_dacdrv

* CDAC, n side
CN5 topn bn5 512f
CN4 topn bn4 256f
CN3 topn bn3 128f
CN2 topn bn2 64f
CN1 topn bn1 32f
CNT topn vrefp 32.8f
XDN5 qn5 bn5 vrefn vrefp vss vdd aa_dacdrv
XDN4 qn4 bn4 vrefn vrefp vss vdd aa_dacdrv
XDN3 qn3 bn3 vrefn vrefp vss vdd aa_dacdrv
XDN2 qn2 bn2 vrefn vrefp vss vdd aa_dacdrv
XDN1 qn1 bn1 vrefn vrefp vss vdd aa_dacdrv

* asynchronous comparator clock: evaluate when not track, not valid, not done
* (validr closes the loop directly; buffered vld only drives the token ring)
XCKC trkd validr done clkc vss vdd aa_nor3
XRD1 clkc rda vss vdd aa_inv
XRD2 rda rdb vss vdd aa_inv
XRST rdb rst vss vdd aa_inv4
XCMP rst topp topn x y vss vdd aa_comp

* decision sensing and valid generation
XXB1 x xb vss vdd aa_invht
XYB1 y yb vss vdd aa_invht
XXB2 xb xbb vss vdd aa_inv2
XYB2 yb ybb vss vdd aa_inv2
XVR xb yb validr vss vdd aa_nand2
XVA validr va vss vdd aa_invsk
XVL va vld vss vdd aa_inv8
XVLB vld vldb vss vdd aa_inv4

* token ring latch phase controls
XFM1 vld trk1 fbm vss vdd aa_nor2
XFM2 fbm fbmb vss vdd aa_inv
XFS1 vldb trk1 fbs vss vdd aa_nor2
XFS2 fbs fbsb vss vdd aa_inv

* one-hot token ring, shifts on valid falling edge, preset t5 during track
XT5 vss t5 vld vldb fbm fbmb fbs fbsb ntrkl vss vdd aa_tok1
XT4 t5 t4 vld vldb fbm fbmb fbs fbsb trk1 vss vdd aa_tok0
XT3 t4 t3 vld vldb fbm fbmb fbs fbsb trk1 vss vdd aa_tok0
XT2 t3 t2 vld vldb fbm fbmb fbs fbsb trk1 vss vdd aa_tok0
XT1 t2 t1 vld vldb fbm fbmb fbs fbsb trk1 vss vdd aa_tok0
XT0 t1 t0 vld vldb fbm fbmb fbs fbsb trk1 vss vdd aa_tok0

* done latch: set at LSB decision, cleared during track
XDSN t0 vld dsn vss vdd aa_nand2
XDQ dsn dqb done vss vdd aa_nand2
XDQB done ntrkl dqb vss vdd aa_nand2

* per-bit decision capture pulses (active low)
XPS5 t5 ybb psn5 vss vdd aa_nand2
XPR5 t5 xbb prn5 vss vdd aa_nand2
XPS4 t4 ybb psn4 vss vdd aa_nand2
XPR4 t4 xbb prn4 vss vdd aa_nand2
XPS3 t3 ybb psn3 vss vdd aa_nand2
XPR3 t3 xbb prn3 vss vdd aa_nand2
XPS2 t2 ybb psn2 vss vdd aa_nand2
XPR2 t2 xbb prn2 vss vdd aa_nand2
XPS1 t1 ybb psn1 vss vdd aa_nand2
XPR1 t1 xbb prn1 vss vdd aa_nand2
XPS0 t0 ybb psn0 vss vdd aa_nand2
XPR0 t0 xbb prn0 vss vdd aa_nand2

* output code latches and pad buffers
XOL5 psn5 prn5 qo5 qob5 vss vdd aa_srl
XOA5 qo5 qox5 vss vdd aa_inv
XOB5 qox5 dout5 vss vdd aa_inv4
XOL4 psn4 prn4 qo4 qob4 vss vdd aa_srl
XOA4 qo4 qox4 vss vdd aa_inv
XOB4 qox4 dout4 vss vdd aa_inv4
XOL3 psn3 prn3 qo3 qob3 vss vdd aa_srl
XOA3 qo3 qox3 vss vdd aa_inv
XOB3 qox3 dout3 vss vdd aa_inv4
XOL2 psn2 prn2 qo2 qob2 vss vdd aa_srl
XOA2 qo2 qox2 vss vdd aa_inv
XOB2 qox2 dout2 vss vdd aa_inv4
XOL1 psn1 prn1 qo1 qob1 vss vdd aa_srl
XOA1 qo1 qox1 vss vdd aa_inv

XOL0 psn0 prn0 qo0 qob0 vss vdd aa_srl
XOA0 qo0 qox0 vss vdd aa_inv

* DAC control latches (bits 5..1), reset to vrefp state during track
XLP5 psn5 ntrkl qp5 vss vdd aa_dacl
XLN5 prn5 ntrkl qn5 vss vdd aa_dacl
XLP4 psn4 ntrkl qp4 vss vdd aa_dacl
XLN4 prn4 ntrkl qn4 vss vdd aa_dacl
XLP3 psn3 ntrkl qp3 vss vdd aa_dacl

XLP2 psn2 ntrkl qp2 vss vdd aa_dacl

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 6-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (sky130, TT/1.8V/27C)
* Architecture:
*  - Top-plate sampling with NMOS switches whose gate is driven to ~VDD+1.7 V
*    by a cross-coupled clock doubler while clks is high (track), and to 0 in
*    hold. Fast, well-defined turn-off isolates the held sample from the
*    post-acquisition decoy.
*  - Monotonic (set-and-up) switching: per side 16/8/4/2/1 Cu binary CDAC
*    (Cu = 16 fF) plus terminating cap; bottom plates start at vrefn and are
*    switched to vrefp by inverter drivers as bits resolve, so the comparator
*    common mode rises from VDD/2 toward vrefp during a conversion.
*  - NMOS(LVT)-input StrongARM comparator strobed by an internally generated
*    asynchronous clock.
*  - Self-timed loop: a qualified decision detector (fires only when the
*    comparator outputs are complementary), a skewed slow-rise delay cell that
*    spaces successive comparisons, a one-hot DFF sequencer clocked on
*    comparator precharge, and NOR SR bit latches that drive the CDAC and the
*    registered outputs.
* Primitive examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

*=========================== basic gate library =============================

.subckt inv1 a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends inv1

.subckt inv2 a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends inv2

.subckt inv4 a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends inv4

.subckt inv8 a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=2
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
.ends inv8

.subckt nand2 a b y vss vdd
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNA y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNB m1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt nand3 a b c y vss vdd
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPC y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNA y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XNB m1 b m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XNC m2 c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
.ends nand3

.subckt nor2 a b y vss vdd
XPA m1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XPB y b m1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends nor2

.subckt nand2f a b y vss vdd
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XNA y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XNB m1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
.ends nand2f

.subckt nor3 a b c y vss vdd
XPA m1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XPB m2 b m1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XPC y c m2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XNC y c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
.ends nor3

* NOR based SR latch: s sets q high, r resets q low (r dominant in this use).
.subckt srl s r q qb vss vdd
Xa r qb q vss vdd nor2
Xb s q qb vss vdd nor2
.ends srl

* small transmission gate used inside flip-flops
.subckt tgc a y gn gp vss vdd
XN y gn a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP y gp a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends tgc

* rising-edge D flip-flop with asynchronous reset (q -> 0); reset is applied
* while the clock input is high in this design, which the structure supports.
.subckt dffr d ck rst q vss vdd
Xcb ck ckb vss vdd inv1
Xci ckb cki vss vdd inv1
Xrb rst rstb vss vdd inv1
Xt1 d ma ckb cki vss vdd tgc
Xmb ma mb vss vdd inv1
Xmf mb rst mfb vss vdd nor2
Xt2 mfb ma cki ckb vss vdd tgc
Xt3 mb sa cki ckb vss vdd tgc
Xqi sa q vss vdd inv1
Xsf q rstb sfb vss vdd nand2
Xt4 sfb sa ckb cki vss vdd tgc
.ends dffr

* rising-edge D flip-flop with asynchronous set (q -> 1)
.subckt dffs d ck st q vss vdd
Xcb ck ckb vss vdd inv1
Xci ckb cki vss vdd inv1
Xsb st stb vss vdd inv1
Xt1 d ma ckb cki vss vdd tgc
Xmb ma mb vss vdd inv1
Xmf mb stb mfb vss vdd nand2
Xt2 mfb ma cki ckb vss vdd tgc
Xt3 mb sa cki ckb vss vdd tgc
Xqi sa q vss vdd inv1
Xsf q st sfb vss vdd nor2
Xt4 sfb sa ckb cki vss vdd tgc
.ends dffs

* Cross-coupled clock doubler: bg is ~0 while smp is low (hold) and about
* vdd+1.5 V while smp is high (track). bg drives the sampling switch gates.
* hld (early inverted clock, one gate from the pin) discharges the small bg
* node quickly at the hold instant so the sample is isolated well before the
* post-acquisition decoy arrives.
.subckt bclk smp smpb hld bg vss vdd
Xd1 b1 b2 vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xd2 b2 b1 vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
C1 smp b1 250f
C2 smpb b2 250f
XPX bg b2 b1 b1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XNG bg hld vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
.ends bclk

* CDAC bottom-plate reference drivers: output low (vrefn) for a=1, switched
* high (vrefp) when the decision latch pulls a low. The rising edge (PMOS)
* is the conversion-critical transition.
.subckt drv16 a y vl vh
XP y a vh vh sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=4
XN y a vl vl sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends drv16

.subckt drv8 a y vl vh
XP y a vh vh sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XN y a vl vl sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 6-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous SAR ADC, SKY130 1.8 V core devices.
* Architecture:
*   - top-plate sampling through two bootstrapped NMOS switches (clks high = acquire)
*   - split-capacitor differential CDAC (each weight split into a half returned to
*     vrefp and a half returned to vrefn), so the comparator common mode stays at
*     the input common mode while the higher side moves down and the lower side up
*   - StrongARM comparator (tail precharged in reset) whose decision flags require
*     one latch output low and the other high
*   - self-timed SAR loop: decision -> comparator reset -> DAC settling delay ->
*     next comparison; the loop stops after the LSB decision
*   - NAND set/reset latches hold the six decisions and drive the outputs
* Calibration: CFP/CFN trim the DAC step to the sampler gain (overall gain 1.000),
* and COFP/COFN add a deliberate +0.25 LSB offset.  With the 64-point coherent
* test tone this keeps the quantization error away from the symmetric worst case
* (a quantizer model using the simulated thresholds gives full-scale-normalized
* ENOB >= 5.93 for every tone phase) while code centers keep >= 0.24 LSB margin.
* All MOS devices use nf=1 (several multi-finger geometries are poorly modeled).

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 6-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous SAR ADC - Sky130 TT 1.8V
* Architecture:
*   - Fully differential top-plate-sampled binary CDAC (unit 20fF, 32 units/side).
*   - "CM-up" monotonic switching: C5 (16u) sampled at vrefn and raised on the
*     lower side after the MSB decision; C4..C1 sampled at vrefp and dropped on
*     the higher side. Comparator common mode stays in 0.9V..1.35V.
*   - NMOS StrongARM comparator, single-phase strobe ck (active high).
*   - Self-timed loop: valid detector -> delay line -> re-strobe. One-hot token
*     DFF chain advances on valid falling edges; NAND capture latches hold the
*     per-bit decisions and drive the DAC; a 7th token stage is "done" which
*     registers the 6 bits into the output DFFs.
*   - Bootstrapped NMOS sampling switches (constant VGS=VDD): fast, linear
*     acquisition; gate grounded when off blocks post-acquisition decoys.

* ---------------- primitive gates ----------------
.subckt inv1 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1

.ends inv2

.subckt inv4 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.8 nf=1
.ends inv4

.subckt inv8 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.8 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9.6 nf=1
.ends inv8

* low switching-threshold inverter (fires only on solid low input)
.subckt invlo a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1

Xg3 q rb qb vss vdd nand2

* Reset (ck=0): o1=o2=vdd. Evaluate (ck=1): the branch of the HIGHER input falls.
* o1 low <=> inp higher.
.subckt cmp ck inp inn o1 o2 vss vdd

* Off (trk=0): gate ng grounded (cascoded pulldown), boot cap ct-cb charged to
* vdd (P3 on since ng=0, its bulk rides ct). On (trk=1): P4 connects ct to ng,
* N5 connects cap bottom to vin, so ng = vin + vdd: constant-VGS switch.
.subckt bsw vin vtop trk trkb vss vdd

XN1A ng vdd nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1

XP4 ng trkb ct ct sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
CB ct cb 300f

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 6-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous SAR ADC (Sky130, TT 1.8 V)
* Architecture: differential top-plate-sampled split-capacitor DAC (half of every
* binary weight starts at vrefp, half at vrefn -> constant comparator common mode),
* MSB compared directly on the held input, StrongARM comparator, self-timed
* asynchronous SAR logic built from static set/reset latches.
* Sampling: bootstrapped NMOS switches (constant Vgs -> fast, signal-independent
* settling and charge injection). Conversion ends ~6.6 ns into each 10 ns period;
* dout bits are held by the SAR latches until the next acquisition.
* Trims: dummy top-plate caps CDP/CDN set unity gain (total 32 units incl. parasitics);
* the comparator's inp-side input device is deliberately wider, giving a +0.26 LSB
* threshold shift that maximises worst-case full-scale-normalised ENOB for the
* 64-sample coherent test while keeping >0.2 LSB margin at every code centre.

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 6-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous SAR ADC (Sky130, fully differential)
* - top-plate sampling through bootstrapped NMOS switches
* - split-capacitor (constant common-mode) CDAC, ideal capacitors
* - StrongARM comparator with low-threshold detectors, self-timed loop,
*   per-bit SR registers armed by the previous bit after comparator reset
* - small post-sampling offset step (Cx, ~0.27 LSB) and dummy-cap gain trim
*   place the thresholds for best worst-case-phase SNDR/ENOB

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- gates

.ends inv_x1

* has reset; set dp (dn) on the next P (N) decision, then disarm itself
.subckt sarbit armed cmpp cmpn rstb dp dpb dn dnb done vdd vss
XA1 armed dpb dnb armn vdd vss nand3_x1
XA2 armn arm vdd vss inv_x1
XS1 arm cmpp sp vdd vss nand2_x1
XS2 arm cmpn sn vdd vss nand2_x1
XL1 sp dpb dp vdd vss nand2_x2
XL2 dp rstb dpb vdd vss nand2_x2
XL3 sn dnb dn vdd vss nand2_x2
XL4 dn rstb dnb vdd vss nand2_x2
XD1 dpb dnb done vdd vss nand2_x1
.ends sarbit

.subckt sarbit_big armed cmpp cmpn rstb dp dpb dn dnb done vdd vss

XA2 armn arm vdd vss inv_x1

XS2 arm cmpn sn vdd vss nand2_x2
XL1 sp dpb dp vdd vss nand2_x4
XL2 dp rstb dpb vdd vss nand2_x4
XL3 sn dnb dn vdd vss nand2_x4
XL4 dn rstb dnb vdd vss nand2_x4

.ends sarbit_big

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* 6-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (sky130 1.8 V)
*
* Bottom-plate sampled differential charge-redistribution CDAC
*   - 32/16/8/4/2/1 unit binary caps + 1 unit dummy per side (64 units)
*   - input applied to the bottom plates during acquisition, both top
*     plates held at an internal vcm ~ VDD/2 by NMOS switches that open
*     first, so the sampling instant is signal independent and the
*     injected charge is identical on both halves (cancels).
*   - during conversion the bottom plates are driven by tri-state
*     inverters from vrefp/vrefn with complementary codes, which keeps
*     the top-plate common mode exactly at vcm and makes the decision
*     thresholds independent of the top-plate parasitics.
* Asynchronous SAR: double-tail dynamic comparator, ready detector,
* self-timed comparator clock and a one-hot shift register that also
* provides the trial bits; the decision memory drives dout directly.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* 6-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (sky130)
*
* Architecture
*  - bottom plate sampling: the input drives the capacitor bottom
*    plates while both top plates are tied to one shared mid rail
*    node.  The decision therefore depends only on capacitor
*    RATIOS: top plate parasitics, their non linearity and the
*    exact value of the mid rail all cancel differentially.
*  - bidirectional (split up/down) capacitive DAC: every bit trial
*    moves one side up and the other side down by the same amount,
*    so the comparator input common mode is constant.
*  - bootstrapped input sampling switches and a boosted top plate
*    switch give a constant, signal independent aperture.
*  - StrongARM comparator with precharged tail; asynchronous self
*    timed SAR loop clocked by the comparator ready signal.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------

* neutral DAC output is exactly mid supply and the array total is

* array total (so gain and sampled charge are untouched).  A

* quantisation error of a symmetric sine from collapsing onto a few

* worst case for a 64 point coherent SNDR measurement.

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 6-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (SKY130, 1.8 V)
*
* Architecture
*   - bottom-plate (top-plate-reset) sampling: the sampled charge is defined by
*     the top-plate switch, so top-plate parasitics and signal dependent charge
*     injection do not enter the comparison.
*   - differential charge-redistribution CDAC using an "up" and a "down" unit per
*     binary step on each side.  Each decision moves one cap up on one side and
*     an identical cap down on the other side, so the comparator input common
*     mode is constant for the whole conversion.
*   - the MSB decision is taken directly on the sampled differential (no DAC
*     step); five further steps of VREF/2 ... VREF/32 complete the 6-bit search.
*   - StrongARM latch comparator in a self-timed asynchronous loop.  A per-bit
*     pointer latch is armed only after the comparator has been reset, which
*     makes the bit sequencing race free without any matched delay.
*   - transparent output register, opened at the end of the conversion and closed
*     at the beginning of the next acquisition, so the outputs hold a full
*     sample period.
*
* Unit capacitance u = 4 fF, total sampling capacitance 64u = 256 fF per side.
* Weights per side: 16u,16u (step VREF/2), 8u,8u, 4u,4u, 2u,2u, 1u,1u and a 2u
* dummy, so the array that samples the input totals exactly 64u and the
* reconstruction levels land on the ideal code centres.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

* The delay-line reset glitches the raw phase taps for ~0.3 ns when the clock
* rises.  The comparator may fire once during that window, but its kickback is
* small and the input switches are on to absorb it.  The de set latches are
* additionally qualified with clksbs so the glitch cannot move a DAC rail.

* ---------------- comparator (shared StrongARM)

* The latch outputs xp/xn must see perfectly matched loads: a single extra
* inverter gate on one side shifts the input-referred offset by more than a
* LSB.  Each side therefore drives exactly two identical buffers, and the
* second 'storage' buffer on the unused (positive) side is terminated with a
* dummy copy of the storage TG/cap/buffer load so both sides track.
* The dummy TG is permanently on (gate at the rails): the real storage TG on
* the other side is on for the whole decision window, so the RC load matches
* at every phase, including the later bits whose ps window differs from ps0.

* The storage chain is deliberately three stages deep: the 20 fF storage
* caps and their transmission gates are switched at the start of every phase,
* and a one-stage buffer couples that glitch straight back to the latch
* output through its Cgd (tens of mV of data-dependent offset).  Two extra
* stages make the kickback negligible.

XMN_S2_N sn1 active sn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2

* Completion and active window: done = dp | dn; active = start & ~done
XNOR_DONE dp dn done_b vdd vss sar_nor2
XINV_DONE done_b done vdd vss sar_inv_d2

* Transparent-high D-latch for registered output bits (updates when en=1, holds when en=0)
.subckt sar_out_latch d en en_b dout vdd vss

* Transmission gate from d_b to q_b

XMP_FB1 fb_p q_int vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMP_FB2 q_b en fb_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1

.subckt sar_adc_6bit_async clks dout5 dout4 dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* 1. Clock buffer and symmetric cross-coupled sampling clock aligner
XINV_CLK1 clks clk_b vdd vss sar_inv_d2
XINV_CLK2 clk_b clk_d vdd vss sar_inv_d2
* Pass gate on clk_b path to balance XINV_CLK2 delay
XMN_PG clk_b_m vdd clk_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
XMP_PG clk_b_m vss clk_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2

XINV_PRE1 clk_d samp_b_pre vdd vss sar_inv_d4

XINV_CC2 samp_pre samp_b_pre vdd vss sar_inv
* Final matched d8 drivers for samp and samp_b
XINV_SAMP samp_b_pre samp vdd vss sar_inv_d8
XINV_SAMPB samp_pre samp_b vdd vss sar_inv_d8

* Delayed reset release for bit latches so output register closes before bit latches reset
XINV_SD1 samp_b samp_d1 vdd vss sar_inv
XINV_SD2 samp_d1 samp_b_lat vdd vss sar_inv_d2

* 2. Front-end differential top-plate sampling switches
XSAMP vinp vinn vtop_p vtop_n samp samp_b vdd vss sar_samp_sw

* 3. Two-stage low-kickback dynamic comparator
XCOMP vtop_p vtop_n comp_clk outp outn vdd vss sar_comparator

* 4. Asynchronous SAR bit slices and inter-bit CDAC settling timers
* Start signal for MSB (bit 5) after sampling switch opens
XDEL5 samp_b start5 samp_b vdd vss sar_start_delay
XBIT5 start5 samp_b_lat outp outn dp5 dn5 dp5_b dn5_b done5 act5 vdd vss sar_bit_slice

* Bit 4
XDEL4 done5 start4 samp_b vdd vss sar_delay_cell

* Bit 3
XDEL3 done4 start3 samp_b vdd vss sar_delay_cell
XBIT3 start3 samp_b_lat outp outn dp3 dn3 dp3_b dn3_b done3 act3 vdd vss sar_bit_slice

* Bit 2
XDEL2 done3 start2 samp_b vdd vss sar_delay_cell
XBIT2 start2 samp_b_lat outp outn dp2 dn2 dp2_b dn2_b done2 act2 vdd vss sar_bit_slice

* Bit 1
XDEL1 done2 start1 samp_b vdd vss sar_delay_cell
XBIT1 start1 samp_b_lat outp outn dp1 dn1 dp1_b dn1_b done1 act1 vdd vss sar_bit_slice

* Bit 0 (LSB)
XDEL0 done1 start0 samp_b vdd vss sar_delay_cell
XBIT0 start0 samp_b_lat outp outn dp0 dn0 dp0_b dn0_b done0 act0 vdd vss sar_bit_slice

* 5. Comparator clock OR tree: comp_clk = act5 | act4 | act3 | act2 | act1 | act0
XNOR_A543 act5 act4 act3 act543_b vdd vss sar_nor3
XNOR_A210 act2 act1 act0 act210_b vdd vss sar_nor3
XNAND_CCLK act543_b act210_b comp_clk vdd vss sar_nand2

* 6. Binary split-capacitor CDAC drivers and capacitor arrays (Cu = 16 fF)
XCDAC5 dp5 dn5 dp5_b dn5_b b5_ph b5_pl b5_nh b5_nl vrefp vrefn sar_cdac_drv
XCDAC4 dp4 dn4 dp4_b dn4_b b4_ph b4_pl b4_nh b4_nl vrefp vrefn sar_cdac_drv
XCDAC3 dp3 dn3 dp3_b dn3_b b3_ph b3_pl b3_nh b3_nl vrefp vrefn sar_cdac_drv
XCDAC2 dp2 dn2 dp2_b dn2_b b2_ph b2_pl b2_nh b2_nl vrefp vrefn sar_cdac_drv
XCDAC1 dp1 dn1 dp1_b dn1_b b1_ph b1_pl b1_nh b1_nl vrefp vrefn sar_cdac_drv

* P-side split capacitor array (weights: 16Cu, 8Cu, 4Cu, 2Cu, 1Cu; each split into two halves, Cu=14fF)
C5_PH vtop_p b5_ph 112f
C5_PL vtop_p b5_pl 112f
C4_PH vtop_p b4_ph 56f
C4_PL vtop_p b4_pl 56f
C3_PH vtop_p b3_ph 28f

C2_PH vtop_p b2_ph 14f

C1_PH vtop_p b1_ph 7f

CTERM_P vtop_p vrefn 7.5f

* N-side split capacitor array
C5_NH vtop_n b5_nh 112f
C5_NL vtop_n b5_nl 112f
C4_NH vtop_n b4_nh 56f
C4_NL vtop_n b4_nl 56f
C3_NH vtop_n b3_nh 28f
C3_NL vtop_n b3_nl 28f
C2_NH vtop_n b2_nh 14f

C1_NH vtop_n b1_nh 7f
C1_NL vtop_n b1_nl 7f
CTERM_N vtop_n vrefn 7.5f

* 7. End-of-conversion output register control: out_en = done0 & clk_b
XNAND_OEN done0 clk_b out_en_b vdd vss sar_nand2
XINV_OEN out_en_b out_en vdd vss sar_inv_d2

XLAT5 dp5 out_en out_en_b dout5 vdd vss sar_out_latch
XLAT4 dp4 out_en out_en_b dout4 vdd vss sar_out_latch
XLAT3 dp3 out_en out_en_b dout3 vdd vss sar_out_latch
XLAT2 dp2 out_en out_en_b dout2 vdd vss sar_out_latch
XLAT1 dp1 out_en out_en_b dout1 vdd vss sar_out_latch
XLAT0 dp0 out_en out_en_b dout0 vdd vss sar_out_latch

.subckt strongarm_comp clk_c clk_cb inp inn cmp_p cmp_n vss vdd

* Differential top-plate sampling switch with charge-injection cancellation
* and cross-coupled OFF switches to neutralize decoy feedthrough.
.subckt diff_samp_sw vinp vinn vtop_p vtop_n samp samp_b vss vdd
* Main sampling switch P
XMNP_main vtop_p samp vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XMPP_main vtop_p samp_b vinp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=4

XMNP_dum vtop_p samp_b vtop_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
XMPP_dum vtop_p samp vtop_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
* Cross-coupled neutralization OFF switch from vinn to vtop_p

XMPP_neut vtop_p vdd vinn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=4

* Main sampling switch N
XMNN_main vtop_n samp vinn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XMPN_main vtop_n samp_b vinn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=4

XMPN_dum vtop_n samp vtop_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
* Cross-coupled neutralization OFF switch from vinp to vtop_n
XMNN_neut vtop_n vss vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XMPN_neut vtop_n vdd vinp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=4
.ends diff_samp_sw

* StrongARM dynamic comparator with kickback neutralization and full reset equalization
.subckt dt_comp vtop_p vtop_n cclk cclk_b outp outn valid_b vss vdd
* Tail current switch
XMN_tail vtail cclk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
* Differential input pair (split into two parallel w=4.0 instances per side)
XMN_in_p1 dp vtop_p vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XMN_in_p2 dp vtop_p vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XMN_in_n1 dn vtop_n vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XMN_in_n2 dn vtop_n vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
* Cross-coupled kickback neutralization
XMN_kbp dn vtop_p dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XMN_kbn dp vtop_n dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4

* Cross-coupled regenerative NMOS pair above dp and dn
* When vtop_p > vtop_n, dp falls faster than dn -> lat_n falls to 0, lat_p stays at vdd
XMN_cc1 lat_n lat_p dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XMN_cc2 lat_p lat_n dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4

* Cross-coupled regenerative PMOS pair at top
XMP_cc1 lat_n lat_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
XMP_cc2 lat_p lat_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2

* Precharge and equalization switches (active when cclk=0)
XMP_rst_dp dp cclk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
XMP_rst_dn dn cclk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
XMP_eq_d   dp cclk dn  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2

XMP_rst_lp lat_p cclk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
XMP_rst_ln lat_n cclk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
XMP_eq_lat lat_p cclk lat_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2

* Mutual-exclusion output buffers:
* During reset: lat_p=1, lat_n=1 -> outp=0, outn=0
* If vtop_p > vtop_n: lat_n=0, lat_p=1 -> outp = ~(lat_n | ~lat_p) = 1, outn = 0
* If vtop_p < vtop_n: lat_p=0, lat_n=1 -> outn = ~(lat_p | ~lat_n) = 1, outp = 0
XINV_lp lat_p lat_pb vss vdd inv_std
XINV_ln lat_n lat_nb vss vdd inv_std
XNOR_op lat_n lat_pb outp vss vdd nor2_std
XNOR_on lat_p lat_nb outn vss vdd nor2_std
XNOR_val outp outn valid_b vss vdd nor2_std
.ends dt_comp

* Asynchronous SAR bit slice
.subckt sar_bit_slice samp_b prev_res_dly cclk_b valid_b outp outn p_bit pb_bit n_bit nb_bit req res res_dly vss vdd
* 1. Enable signal: en = samp_b & prev_res_dly
XNAND_en samp_b prev_res_dly enb vss vdd nand2_std
XINV_en enb en vss vdd inv_std

* 2. P latch (pb active low, sets to 0 when en=1 & nb=1 & outp=1)
XMP_p_rst pb samp_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMP_p_kp pb p_bit vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=0.42 nf=1
XMN_p_sb p_bot samp_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=2

XINV_p pb p_bit vss vdd inv_std
XINV_pb p_bit pb_bit vss vdd inv_std

* 3. N latch (nb active low, sets to 0 when en=1 & pb=1 & outn=1)
XMP_n_rst nb samp_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMP_n_kp nb n_bit vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=0.42 nf=1

XMN_n_s3 n_n2 outn n_bot vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=2
XINV_n nb n_bit vss vdd inv_std
XINV_nb n_bit nb_bit vss vdd inv_std

* 4. Resolved and Request logic
XNOR_res p_bit n_bit res_b vss vdd nor2_std
XINV_res res_b res vss vdd inv_std
XNAND_req en res_b req_b vss vdd nand2_std
XINV_req req_b req vss vdd inv_std
XDLY_res res res_dly vss vdd dly_chain6
.ends sar_bit_slice

* Split-capacitor bottom-plate driver for one bit pair on vtop_p and vtop_n
* Before bit resolves: p_bit=0 (pb_bit=1), n_bit=0 (nb_bit=1)
* We need:
*   bot_p_hi = ~p_bit = VREFP initially, goes to VREFN if p_bit=1
*   bot_p_lo =  n_bit = VREFN initially, goes to VREFP if n_bit=1
*   bot_n_hi = ~n_bit = VREFP initially, goes to VREFN if n_bit=1
*   bot_n_lo =  p_bit = VREFN initially, goes to VREFP if p_bit=1
* Since inv_drv is an inverter:
*   bot_p_hi = inv_drv(p_bit)
*   bot_p_lo = inv_drv(nb_bit)
*   bot_n_hi = inv_drv(n_bit)
*   bot_n_lo = inv_drv(pb_bit)
.subckt cdac_bit_drv p_bit pb_bit n_bit nb_bit bot_p_hi bot_p_lo bot_n_hi bot_n_lo vrefn vrefp
XDRV_phi p_bit bot_p_hi vrefn vrefp inv_drv
XDRV_plo nb_bit bot_p_lo vrefn vrefp inv_drv
XDRV_nhi n_bit bot_n_hi vrefn vrefp inv_drv
XDRV_nlo pb_bit bot_n_lo vrefn vrefp inv_drv
.ends cdac_bit_drv

.subckt out_dlatch d le leb q vss vdd
XINV_d d db vss vdd inv_std
* Pass gate when le=1
XMN_pg db le m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP_pg db leb m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
* Forward inverter to internal node q_int

* Feedback tristate inverter when le=0
XMP_fb1 fb_p q_int vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP_fb2 m le fb_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

XMN_fb2 m leb fb_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
* Output buffer driving 10 fF
XINV_buf1 q_int qb vss vdd inv_std
XINV_buf2 qb q vss vdd inv_drv
.ends out_dlatch

.subckt sar_adc_6bit_async clks dout5 dout4 dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* 1. Clock buffering: clks=1 is acquisition, clks=0 is conversion
XINV_clk1 clks samp_b vss vdd inv_std
XINV_clk2 samp_b samp vss vdd inv_std

XDEL_s1 samp_b sb_d1 vss vdd inv_del

XCOMP vtop_p vtop_n cclk cclk_b outp outn valid_b vss vdd dt_comp

XBIT4 samp_b res5_dly   cclk_b valid_b outp outn p4 pb4 n4 nb4 req4 res4 res4_dly vss vdd sar_bit_slice

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
*=====================================================================
* 6-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous SAR ADC in Sky130 1.8V CMOS.
*
* Top-level subcircuit (deliverable):
*   .subckt sar_adc_6bit_async clks dout5 dout4 dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0
*                            vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
*
* Architecture:
*  - Fully differential charge-redistribution CDAC (Cu ~ 10 fF, 64C/array:
*    binary weights 32C..1C + 1C termination), bottom-plate sampling.
*  - Symmetric P/N switching: bit=1 -> P cap to VDD, N cap to VSS;
*    bit=0 -> the opposite.  Keeps comparator common mode near VDD/2 and
*    makes every decision threshold exactly w/64*VDD (Vcm independent).
*  - Self-timed asynchronous sequencer: shift-token windows tok5..tok0
*    advanced on each comparator-ready edge.  Token b gates bit-b's value
*    capture and drives bit-(b+1)'s bottom switches (done for bit0).
*  - Dynamic StrongARM comparator, precharged between compares by a fixed
*    one-shot (overlaps CDAC re-settling).
*  - Internal half-supply reference: capacitive divider (vdd/vss) plus a
*    small switched-cap trim pump.
*
* Devices: only official Sky130 PDK wrappers (sky130_fd_pr__{n,p}fet_01v8)
* and positive ideal capacitors.
*=====================================================================

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Logic leaf cells
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv in out vdd vss
XN0 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XP0 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt invs in out vdd vss

.ends invs

.ends invw

.subckt buf in out vdd vss
Xi1 in n1 vdd vss inv
Xi2 n1 out vdd vss inv
.ends buf

.subckt nand2 a b y vdd vss
XN0 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1
XN1 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1

* Comparator: dynamic StrongARM latch.
*   compare enabled when ck=1; op/on precharged high when ck=0.
*   op falls if ip > in.

XMN1 op ip t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 6-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC.
* Vcm-based CDAC: top plates sampled to internal VDD/2, bottom plates to the
* differential inputs; after sampling all bottoms move to Vcm (zero net charge
* because input CM = VDD/2). The MSB is the raw sign comparison, then five
* trials (weights 32,16,8,4,2) steer the binary search. Comparator CM stays at
* VDD/2 throughout. A StrongARM latch plus self-timed valid/token loop runs the
* six comparisons asynchronously; static D-latches register each result.
.subckt sar_adc_6bit_async clks dout5 dout4 dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* ---- clock buffers: clkb = conversion-active (clks inverted), clkbb = sample ----
XCB0 clks cb1 inv
XCB1 cb1 cb2 inv
XCB2 cb2 clkb inv_b
XCB3 clkb clkbb inv_b
* ---- internal VDD/2 reference: two matched high-poly resistors + decap ----
XRV1 vdd vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=150
XRV2 vcm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=150
CVC vcm vss 1p
* ---- CDAC top plates and capacitors (64 units of 5 fF per side) ----
XTOP vp vcm clkbb clkb tg_b
XTON vn vcm clkbb clkb tg_b
CCP32 vp bp32 160f
CCP16 vp bp16 80f
CCP8  vp bp8  40f
CCP4  vp bp4  20f
CCP2  vp bp2  10f
CCP1  vp bp1  5f
CCPD  vp bpd  5f
CCN32 vn bn32 160f
CCN16 vn bn16 80f
CCN8  vn bn8  40f
CCN4  vn bn4  20f
CCN2  vn bn2  10f
CCN1  vn bn1  5f
CCND  vn bnd  5f
* ---- bottom-plate sampling switches ----
XSP32 bp32 vinp clkbb clkb tg
XSP16 bp16 vinp clkbb clkb tg
XSP8  bp8  vinp clkbb clkb tg
XSP4  bp4  vinp clkbb clkb tg
XSP2  bp2  vinp clkbb clkb tg
XSP1  bp1  vinp clkbb clkb tg
XSPD  bpd  vinp clkbb clkb tg
XSN32 bn32 vinn clkbb clkb tg
XSN16 bn16 vinn clkbb clkb tg
XSN8  bn8  vinn clkbb clkb tg
XSN4  bn4  vinn clkbb clkb tg
XSN2  bn2  vinn clkbb clkb tg
XSN1  bn1  vinn clkbb clkb tg
XSND  bnd  vinn clkbb clkb tg
* ---- comparator ----
XCMP vp vn cck vss vdd cop con sacomp
XCD0 cop cd1 inv
XCD1 cd1 cd inv
* ---- valid flag v = !(cop & con); reset state has both high ----
XVD cop con v nand2
XVL v vn_l inv_s
* delay chain on v for rise/fall edge pulses
XDV1 v dv1 inv_s
XDV2 dv1 dv2 inv_s
XDVN dv2 dv2n inv_s
* vr: one-shot on v rising (latch capture); vf: one-shot on v falling (advance)
XVR v dv2n vr and2
XVF vn_l dv2 vf and2
* delayed vf for token reset (break-before-race)
XDF1 vf df1 inv_s
XDF2 df1 vfd inv_s
* ---- edge one-shot on clks falling ----
XDC1 clkb dc1 inv_s
XDC2 dc1 dc2 inv_s
XDCN dc2 dc2n inv_s
XCF clkb dc2n cf and2
* ---- one-hot token chain; sampling presets t5, clears the rest ----
XT5S cf clkbb t5s or2
XT5R vfd clkbb t5r or2
XT5 t5s t5r vss vdd t5 t5n sr_nor
XT4S vf t5 t4s and2
XT4R vfd clkbb t4r or2
XT4 t4s t4r vss vdd t4 t4n sr_nor
XT3S vf t4 t3s and2
XT3R vfd clkbb t3r or2
XT3 t3s t3r vss vdd t3 t3n sr_nor
XT2S vf t3 t2s and2
XT2R vfd clkbb t2r or2
XT2 t2s t2r vss vdd t2 t2n sr_nor
XT1S vf t2 t1s and2
XT1R vfd clkbb t1r or2
XT1 t1s t1r vss vdd t1 t1n sr_nor
XT0S vf t1 t0s and2
XT0R vfd clkbb t0r or2
XT0 t0s t0r vss vdd t0 t0n sr_nor
* ---- comparator clock SR: set when token present & reset complete ----
XOK1 t5 t4 o41 nor2
XOK2 t3 t2 o42 nor2
XOK3 t1 t0 o43 nor2
XOK4 o41 o42 o44 nor2
XOK5 o44 o43 tokany nor2
XCCS clkb tokany vn_l sccraw and3
XSC1 sccraw sc1 inv_s
XSC2 sc1 scc inv_s
XCC scc v vss vdd cc ccn sr_nor
XCBUF0 cc ccb1 inv
XCBUF1 ccb1 cck inv_b
* ---- trial-executed latches e5..e1 (weights 32,16,8,4,2) ----
XSE5 vr t5 se5 and2
XE5 se5 clkbb vss vdd e5 e5n sr_nor
XSE4 vr t4 se4 and2
XE4 se4 clkbb vss vdd e4 e4n sr_nor
XSE3 vr t3 se3 and2
XE3 se3 clkbb vss vdd e3 e3n sr_nor
XSE2 vr t2 se2 and2
XE2 se2 clkbb vss vdd e2 e2n sr_nor
XSE1 vr t1 se1 and2
XE1 se1 clkbb vss vdd e1 e1n sr_nor
* ---- DAC switching for each trial: vcm TGs and rail switches ----
* weight 32, p/n
XGV5 clkb e5n gv5 and2
XGV5N gv5 gv5n inv_s
XTGP5 bp32 vcm gv5 gv5n tg_b
XTGN5 bn32 vcm gv5 gv5n tg_b
XPP5 bp32 q5 e5 vdd vrefp pswitch
XPN5 bn32 qn5 e5 vdd vrefp pswitch
XNP5 bp32 qn5 e5 vss vrefn nswitch
XNN5 bn32 q5 e5 vss vrefn nswitch
* weight 16
XGV4 clkb e4n gv4 and2
XGV4N gv4 gv4n inv_s
XTGP4 bp16 vcm gv4 gv4n tg_b
XTGN4 bn16 vcm gv4 gv4n tg_b
XPP4 bp16 q4 e4 vdd vrefp pswitch
XPN4 bn16 qn4 e4 vdd vrefp pswitch
XNP4 bp16 qn4 e4 vss vrefn nswitch
XNN4 bn16 q4 e4 vss vrefn nswitch
* weight 8
XGV3 clkb e3n gv3 and2
XGV3N gv3 gv3n inv_s
XTGP3 bp8 vcm gv3 gv3n tg_b
XTGN3 bn8 vcm gv3 gv3n tg_b
XPP3 bp8 q3 e3 vdd vrefp pswitch
XPN3 bn8 qn3 e3 vdd vrefp pswitch
XNP3 bp8 qn3 e3 vss vrefn nswitch
XNN3 bn8 q3 e3 vss vrefn nswitch
* weight 4
XGV2 clkb e2n gv2 and2
XGV2N gv2 gv2n inv_s
XTGP2 bp4 vcm gv2 gv2n tg_b
XTGN2 bn4 vcm gv2 gv2n tg_b
XPP2 bp4 q2 e2 vdd vrefp pswitch
XPN2 bn4 qn2 e2 vdd vrefp pswitch
XNP2 bp4 qn2 e2 vss vrefn nswitch
XNN2 bn4 q2 e2 vss vrefn nswitch
* weight 2
XGV1 clkb e1n gv1 and2
XGV1N gv1 gv1n inv_s
XTGP1 bp2 vcm gv1 gv1n tg_b
XTGN1 bn2 vcm gv1 gv1n tg_b
XPP1 bp2 q1 e1 vdd vrefp pswitch
XPN1 bn2 qn1 e1 vdd vrefp pswitch
XNP1 bp2 qn1 e1 vss vrefn nswitch
XNN1 bn2 q1 e1 vss vrefn nswitch
* ---- weight-1 and dummy: hold Vcm for the whole conversion ----
XTGP1X bp1 vcm clkb clkbb tg
XTGN1X bn1 vcm clkb clkbb tg
XTGPDX bpd vcm clkb clkbb tg
XTGNDX bnd vcm clkb clkbb tg
* ---- bit registers: D-latches enabled only during their token's valid pulse ----
XEN5 v t5 en5 and2
XL5 cd en5 vss vdd q5 qn5 dlatch
XEN4 v t4 en4 and2
XL4 cd en4 vss vdd q4 qn4 dlatch
XEN3 v t3 en3 and2
XL3 cd en3 vss vdd q3 qn3 dlatch
XEN2 v t2 en2 and2
XL2 cd en2 vss vdd q2 qn2 dlatch
XEN1 v t1 en1 and2
XL1 cd en1 vss vdd q1 qn1 dlatch
XEN0 v t0 en0 and2
XL0 cd en0 vss vdd q0 qn0 dlatch
* ---- output buffers (each pin carries 10 fF externally) ----
XOB5A q5 ob5 inv
XOB5B ob5 dout5 inv_out
XOB4A q4 ob4 inv
XOB4B ob4 dout4 inv_out
XOB3A q3 ob3 inv
XOB3B ob3 dout3 inv_out
XOB2A q2 ob2 inv
XOB2B ob2 dout2 inv_out
XOB1A q1 ob1 inv
XOB1B ob1 dout1 inv_out
XOB0A q0 ob0 inv
XOB0B ob0 dout0 inv_out
.ends sar_adc_6bit_async
*
* =====================================================================
* Local standard cells (parameter-free)
* =====================================================================
.subckt inv a y
XN y a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP y a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1

.subckt inv_s a y
XN y a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP y a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends inv_s
.subckt inv_b a y
XN y a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

.ends inv_b
.subckt inv_out a y
XN y a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XP y a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends inv_out
.subckt nand2 a b y
XN1 y a nx sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XN2 nx b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends nand2
.subckt nor2 a b y
XP1 vdd a nx sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 nx b y sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN1 y a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XN2 y b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends nor2
.subckt and2 a b y
XNAND a b n1 nand2
XINV n1 y inv
.ends and2
.subckt nand3 a b c y
XN1 y a nx1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XN2 nx1 b nx2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XN3 nx2 c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP3 y c vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends nand3
.subckt and3 a b c y
XNAND a b c n1 nand3
XINV n1 y inv
.ends and3
.subckt or2 a b y
XNOR a b n1 nor2
XINV n1 y inv
.ends or2
.subckt tg io1 io2 en en_n
XN io1 en io2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.75 nf=1
XP io1 en_n io2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
.ends tg
.subckt tg_b io1 io2 en en_n
XN io1 en io2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

.subckt dlatch d en vss vdd q qn

* 6-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous fully differential SAR ADC.
*
* Top-plate (tp/tn) sampling to internal vcmx; differential CDAC bottom
* plates sample the inputs, wait at vcmx, then switch to vrefp/vrefn in the
* Vcm-based monotonic sequence (one cap on each side per decision), which
* keeps the comparator input common mode constant at vcmx.
* An NMOS-input strong-arm comparator runs at that common mode; the
* asynchronous loop is a val/ckc ring with a 6-stage one-hot token chain.
* vcmx is defined by a strong divider only during the first acquisition
* (one-shot latch), then held on capacitors.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- basic gates
.subckt inv a z vss vdd
xn z a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
xp z a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends inv

.ends inv4

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* =====================================================================
*  sar_adc_6bit_async
*  6-bit fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC, 100 MS/s, SKY130 PDK
*
*  Architecture
*    - Top-plate sampling: a CMOS transmission gate connects vinp/vinn
*      to the differential CDAC top plates while clks is high.
*    - Binary-weighted differential charge-redistribution DAC
*      (weights 32,16,8,4,2,1 unit caps plus one termination cap per
*      side, C_u = 20 fF, C_tot = 64*C_u = 1.28 pF).
*    - Six dynamic comparators, one per bit, fired by a self-timed
*      asynchronous sequencer: bit j fires one DAC-settling delay after
*      bit j-1 has been decided.
*
*  Phases
*    smp   = clks  (high during the 2 ns acquisition)
*    smp_b = NOT smp                          (high during conversion)
*    cnv_b = NOT smp_b = smp                  (resets all latches during
*                                              acquisition, one inverter
*                                              after the sample gate opens)
*    conv  = latch(set=smp_b, rst=cnv_b)      (conversion-start flag; is
*                                              0 at the DC operating
*                                              point, which keeps every
*                                              comparator precharged and
*                                              makes the OP well defined)
*
*  DAC switch convention (one gate per bottom plate, no shoot-through)
*    gate = 1 : NMOS on  -> bottom plate at vrefn
*    gate = 0 : PMOS on  -> bottom plate at vrefp
*    Undecided / acquisition : both gates high (all plates at vrefn)
*    ga = NAND(NOT b, c)   gb = NAND(b, c)   with c = "bit decided"
*
*  Comparator polarity: na falls when vxp > vxn  ->  bit = 1 and the
*    N-side plate of that weight is thrown to vrefp (reduces vxp-vxn).
*
*  Residual before deciding the bit of weight w_j is
*    (VDD*C_u/C_tot) * sum_{i<=j} (2*b_i - 1)*w_i ,
*    i.e. at least one LSB away from zero at every code centre, so the
*    comparator never has to resolve a metastable input.
* =====================================================================

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Elementary logic gates
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv a vdd vss y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
.ends inv

.subckt invb a vdd vss y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
.ends invb

.subckt invd a vdd vss y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
.ends invd

* slow inverter used as a delay element
.subckt invs a vdd vss y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42
.ends invs

.subckt nand2 a b vdd vss y
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5
XMN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.75
XMN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.75
.ends nand2

.subckt nor2 a b vdd vss y
XMP1 n1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMP2 y b n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.75
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.75
.ends nor2

.subckt nor3 a b c vdd vss y
XMP1 n1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.5
XMP2 n2 b n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.5
XMP3 y c n2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.5
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5
XMN3 y c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5
.ends nor3

* buffered nand used to drive DAC switch gates
.subckt nandb a b vdd vss y
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6
XMN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XMN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
.ends nandb

* DAC-settling delay cell: six inversions, so out = in (delayed)
.subckt dly in vdd vss out
XD1 in vdd vss n1 inv
XD2 n1 vdd vss n2 invs
XD3 n2 vdd vss n3 invs
XD4 n3 vdd vss n4 invs
XD5 n4 vdd vss n5 invs
XD6 n5 vdd vss out inv
.ends dly

* set-dominant sticky latch with two independent reset inputs
*   q  = NOR3(r0, r1, qb)      qb = NOR2(set, q)
*   r0 or r1 high  -> q = 0 ;  set high (with both resets low) -> q = 1
.subckt sl3 set r0 r1 vdd vss q qb
XN1 r0 r1 qb vdd vss q nor3
XN2 set q  vdd vss qb nor2
.ends sl3

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Sampling transmission gate (on when sc high, scb = NOT sc)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt stg in out sc scb vdd vss
XMN in sc out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XP in scb out vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
.ends stg

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Dynamic comparator.
*   fire low  : na, nb and the tail node s precharged high
*   fire high : evaluation; na falls when vxp > vxn, else nb falls
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cmp vxp vxn fire vdd vss na nb
XPA na fire vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XPB nb fire vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XP1 na nb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XP2 nb na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XPF s fire vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XN1 na nb s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XN2 nb na s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XNA na vxp s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42
XNB nb vxn s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42
XT s fire vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
.ends cmp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Bit slice: comparator, decision latches, DAC gate drivers, output
*   dcin : "previous bit decided" (conv for the first slice)
*   dcout: this bit's decided flag, feeding the next slice
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt bs vxp vxn smp cnv_b dcin vdd vss ga gb dout dcout
XC   vxp   vxn   fire vdd vss na    nb   cmp
XDO  na    nb    vdd  vss done  nand2
XSA  na    vdd   vss  sa  inv
XSB  nb    vdd   vss  sb  inv
XBL  sa    cnv_b vss  vdd vss b     nbb  sl3
XDC  done  cnv_b vss  vdd vss c     ncc  sl3
XGA  nbb   c     vdd  vss ga   nandb
XGB  b     c     vdd  vss gb   nandb
XDL  dcin  vdd   vss  dcl dly
XDB  dcl   vdd   vss  dclb inv
XNF  smp   dclb  c    vdd vss fire nor3
XO1  b     vdd   vss  o1  inv
XO2  o1    vdd   vss  dout invd
.ends bs

* =====================================================================
* Top level
* =====================================================================
.subckt sar_adc_6bit_async clks dout5 dout4 dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

* ---------------- clock phase generation ----------------
XCG1 clks  vdd vss n1    inv
XCG2 n1    vdd vss smp   invd
XCG3 smp   vdd vss smp_b invd
XCG4 smp_b vdd vss cnv_b inv

* conversion-start flag: set at the beginning of the conversion,
* cleared throughout the acquisition (and at the DC operating point)
XC0  smp_b cnv_b vss vdd vss conv nconv sl3

* ---------------- sampling transmission gates ----------------
XTGP vinp xp smp smp_b vdd vss stg
XTGN vinn xn smp smp_b vdd vss stg

* Weak subthreshold leakage to vrefp.  The top plates are otherwise
* purely capacitive nodes with no DC path, and at the operating point
* (clks low, i.e. the conversion phase) every comparator would evaluate
* with vxp == vxn and sit in the degenerate state of its regenerative
* pair.  Both devices are off (VSG = 0); the N-side one is slightly
* wider so vxp > vxn at the operating point and every comparator
* resolves.  The resulting differential droop over the 7 ns conversion
* is ~2 mV, about 0.07 LSB.
XLEAKP xp vdd vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.42
XLEAKN xn vdd vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.5

XMPA6 ap6 ga6 vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XMNA6 ap6 ga6 vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2

CN4   xn an2 320f

CN2   xn an4 80f

CPADN xn vrefn 20f

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* Six-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous sampled-data ADC.
* A physical SKY130 reference ladder drives 63 clocked regenerative
* comparators.  They reset during acquisition, resolve on the falling edge,
* and retain their decisions throughout conversion.  Compact static window
* decoders produce the six held output bits.
*
.subckt adc_inv a y vss vdd
XIP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XIN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends adc_inv

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 6-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (Sky130).
* Top-plate sampling, monotonic set-and-up CDAC switching, NMOS-input
* StrongArm comparator, self-timed asynchronous bit-cycle control.

* --- basic gates ---------------------------------------------------------
.subckt s6a_inv a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
.ends s6a_inv

.subckt s6a_invb a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0
.ends s6a_invb

.subckt s6a_invb2 a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0
.ends s6a_invb2

.subckt s6a_nor2 a b y vdd vss
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XP1 np a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP2 y b np vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
.ends s6a_nor2

.subckt s6a_nor2b a b y vdd vss
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP1 np a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP2 y b np vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
.ends s6a_nor2b

.subckt s6a_nand2 a b y vdd vss
XN1 y a ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XN2 ns b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
.ends s6a_nand2

.subckt s6a_nand3 a b c y vdd vss
XN1 y a ns1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XN2 ns1 b ns2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XN3 ns2 c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84

.subckt s6a_and2 a b y vdd vss
X1 a b n vdd vss s6a_nand2

.subckt s6a_and3 a b c y vdd vss

.subckt s6a_and3b2 a b c y vdd vss

* SR latch, active-high set/reset, reset dominant when both high
.subckt s6a_srl s r q qb vdd vss
XQ r qb q vdd vss s6a_nor2b
XQB s q qb vdd vss s6a_nor2b
.ends s6a_srl

* --- NMOS-input StrongArm comparator ------------------------------------
* evaluate when cclk=1; reset (opb=onb=0) when cclk=0; onb=1 iff vip>vin.
* Degeneration-free output stage; input CM stays near vdd/2 by design.
.subckt s6a_comp vip vin cclk opb onb vdd vss
XN0 t cclk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0
XN1 a1 vip t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0
XN2 a2 vin t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0
XP3 a1 a2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP4 a2 a1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XP5 a1 cclk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP6 a2 cclk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XN7 op a1 fn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XN8 on a2 fn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68
XNF fn cclk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0
XP9 on op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP10 op on vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP11 op cclk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XP12 on cclk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XI1 op opb vdd vss s6a_invb2
XI2 on onb vdd vss s6a_invb2
.ends s6a_comp

* --- bootstrapped sampling switch ---------------------------------------
* track (clks=1): gate ng = out + vdd; hold (clks=0): ng = 0, Cb recharged
.subckt s6a_bsamp in out clks conv vdd vss
XSW out ng in vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4.0
XPC b1 ng vdd b1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0
XNB b2 conv vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0
XNG ng conv vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0
XN2 b2 clks out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0
XP2 b2 conv out vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0
XPP2 ng conv b1 b1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0
CB1 b1 b2 100f
.ends s6a_bsamp

* --- one SAR bit slice ---------------------------------------------------
* gset/gclr : stage set/clear; cclk : comparator clock; valid/opb/onb :
* comparator status; clks : sample clock (acquisition reset); sq/vq/vqb :
* stage/valid flags; dout : registered bit; botp/botn : CDAC bottom plates.
* Vcm-based symmetric switching: decision 1 -> cp side down, cn side up.
.subckt s6a_bit gset gclr cclk valid opb onb clks ncclk dn sq vq vqb vqf dout botp botn vcm vrefp vrefn vdd vss
XOR1 gclr clks sr vdd vss s6a_or2
XSL gset sr sq sqb vdd vss s6a_srl
XGC gclr gclrb vdd vss s6a_inv
XG sq cclk gclrb gc vdd vss s6a_and3
XSV gc valid sv vdd vss s6a_and2
XVR clks dn vr vdd vss s6a_or2
XVL sv vr vq vqb vdd vss s6a_srl
XVB1 vq vqbb vdd vss s6a_invb
XVB2 vqbb vqf vdd vss s6a_invb
XS gc onb sqs vdd vss s6a_and2
XR gc opb sqr vdd vss s6a_and2
XQL sqs sqr q qb vdd vss s6a_srl
* u0 = decided-0 (cp up / cn down), u1 = decided-1 (cp down / cn up)
XU0 vq qb u0 vdd vss s6a_and2
XU1 vq q u1 vdd vss s6a_and2
XU0B u0 u0b vdd vss s6a_inv
XU1B u1 u1b vdd vss s6a_inv
XPP botp u0b vrefp vrefp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7.0
XPN botp u1 vrefn vrefn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.5
XPTN botp vqbb vcm vrefn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0
XPTP botp vqf vcm vrefp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0
XNP botn u1b vrefp vrefp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7.0
XNN botn u0 vrefn vrefn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.5
XNTN botn vqbb vcm vrefn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0
XNTP botn vqf vcm vrefp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0
XOB1 q db vdd vss s6a_inv
XOB2 db dout vdd vss s6a_invb
.ends s6a_bit

* --- top-level ADC -------------------------------------------------------
.subckt sar_adc_6bit_async clks dout5 dout4 dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* sample-clock buffer: conv=1 during conversion (clks low)

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 6-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (Sky130, 1.8 V).
*
* Architecture:
*  - Bottom-plate sampling: during clks=1 the top plates are held at vss and
*    the capacitor bottom plates track the differential input through
*    transmission gates.  At the clks falling edge the top-plate switch opens
*    first, the dump PMOS presets every bottom plate to vrefp (~100 ps later,
*    before the input may move), then the input TGs open.  Top plates sit at
*    vdd-vinp / vdd-vinn, always inside the rails.
*  - Six asynchronous set-and-down comparisons: MSB taken directly (immune to
*    initial settling scale), then weights 16/8/4/2/1 (32 Cu per side incl.
*    dummy).  Each decision dumps the losing side's capacitor to vrefn.
*  - PMOS-input double-tail dynamic comparator (input CM <= 0.9 V).  Outputs
*    precharge high; lp stays high when vtop_p < vtop_n (vinp > vinn => bit 1).
*  - Self-timed token ring: armed latch + five DFFs clocked by delayed valid;
*    compclk = tok_any & ~valid_d & first-bit-settle-qualifier.
*
* Only X (PDK MOS / local subcircuits) and ideal C elements.

* ---------------- basic gates ----------------

XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42

.ends g_inv

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* Six-bit fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC, 100 MS/s, Sky130.
*
* Architecture:
*  - Bottom-plate sampling of vinp/vinn onto a binary-weighted differential
*    capacitor array (32..1 units + 1 dummy, unit 25 fF) while the top plates
*    are preset to the internal mid-supply node vcmi.
*  - After sampling, every bottom plate is moved to vcmi, placing the full
*    differential input on the top plates.
*  - Binary-search switching: for decision j the pair of bit-j capacitors is
*    switched from vcmi to (vrefp, vrefn) if the bit is 1 and to
*    (vrefn, vrefp) on the (p, n) sides if the bit is 0.  Differential steps
*    are independent of the vcmi value, which is generated by a matched
*    resistor divider.
*  - Dynamic comparator (diode-load preamp + strong-arm latch) is enabled
*    once per decision by a one-hot asynchronous stage chain clocked by the
*    comparator's own done pulse.
*  - A final register holds the six decision bits until the next conversion
*    completes and drives the output pins.
*
* Primitive gates and helpers.

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 6-bit fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC, Sky130 1.8 V, 100 MS/s.
*
* Architecture:
*  - Top-plate sampling: vinp/vinn are sampled directly onto the two
*    capacitor-array top plates while the clks pulse is high.
*  - Binary weighted fully differential CDAC, 32..1 units per side plus one
*    dummy unit per side tied to vrefp.
*  - Monotonic switching: bottom plates idle at vrefp; after each decision
*    the selected side's cap of that weight is flipped to vrefn.
*    d_i = 1 (topp > topn) -> p-side cap i to vrefn,
*    d_i = 0                -> n-side cap i to vrefn.
*    Weight on the differential residue is vdd * Ci/Ctot = vdd*2^i/64.
*  - Strongarm latch comparator, self-timed asynchronous SAR loop:
*    valid = NAND(outp,outn) pulses on each decision; a narrow capture
*    strobe cp = vd4 & !vd6 clocks the bit registers, and
*    cck = go & !done0 & !vd6 keeps the precharge/evaluate cycle going
*    until all six bits are resolved.

* ---------------- primitive gates / switches / flops ----------------

XTSN vinn topn sn sdrv vdd vss tg_xx

* Subthreshold bleeders so the floating top plates have a defined DC
* operating point (leakage is pA-scale, irrelevant at 100 MS/s).
XBLP topp vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=0.42 nf=1
XBLN topn vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=0.42 nf=1
* Weak pull-up on done0 defines the idle state at DC (cck low, outputs
* precharged); the done register is actively reset on every acquisition.
XWU0 done0 vss vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=0.42 nf=1

* ---- capacitive DAC, p side ----
C5P topp bp5 128f
C4P topp bp4 64f
C3P topp bp3 32f
C2P topp bp2 16f
C1P topp bp1 8f
C0P topp bp0 4f
CDP topp vrefp 4f

C4N topn bn4 64f
C3N topn bn3 32f
C2N topn bn2 16f
C1N topn bn1 8f
C0N topn bn0 4f

* ---- bottom-plate switches ----
* SR: TG to vrefn, on when this cap is selected by its decision.
* SF: TG to vrefp, on otherwise. Both are transmission gates whose
* n/p devices switch in opposite directions, so the channel charge
* dumped onto the bottom plate largely cancels at every decision.
XSR5P bp5 vrefn sw5p swb5p vdd vss tg_xl
XSF5P bp5 vrefp swb5p sw5p vdd vss tg_xl
XSR4P bp4 vrefn sw4p swb4p vdd vss tg_l
XSF4P bp4 vrefp swb4p sw4p vdd vss tg_l

XSF1P bp1 vrefp swb1p sw1p vdd vss tg_s
XSR0P bp0 vrefn sw0p swb0p vdd vss tg_s
XSF0P bp0 vrefp swb0p sw0p vdd vss tg_s

XSR5N bn5 vrefn sw5n swb5n vdd vss tg_xl
XSF5N bn5 vrefp swb5n sw5n vdd vss tg_xl
XSR4N bn4 vrefn sw4n swb4n vdd vss tg_l
XSF4N bn4 vrefp swb4n sw4n vdd vss tg_l
XSR3N bn3 vrefn sw3n swb3n vdd vss tg_m
XSF3N bn3 vrefp swb3n sw3n vdd vss tg_m
XSR2N bn2 vrefn sw2n swb2n vdd vss tg_s
XSF2N bn2 vrefp swb2n sw2n vdd vss tg_s

XSF1N bn1 vrefp swb1n sw1n vdd vss tg_s
XSR0N bn0 vrefn sw0n swb0n vdd vss tg_s
XSF0N bn0 vrefp swb0n sw0n vdd vss tg_s

* ---- strongarm latch comparator ----
* Pmos input pair and pmos tail: the monotonic switching sequence drags
* the top-plate common mode down toward vrefn as bits resolve, so an
* nmos pair would cut off mid-conversion. The pmos pair stays in
* saturation for the whole common-mode range.
* outn discharges when topn is the lower input, so the latch resolves
* outp=1/outn=0 for topp > topn: outp is the decision bit.

XMN outn cck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2

XIN outn topn tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XTL tail cckb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
* The latch nfets sit on a cck-gated cascode so they cannot fight the
* precharge devices between decisions (which would leave outp/outn
* asymmetric and offset the next comparison).
XLN ln cck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XLAN outn outp ln vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XLAO outn outp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XLBN outp outn ln vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XLBO outp outn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* valid rises when either comparator output falls (decision ready).
* The vd chain delays it; cp = vd4 & !vd6 is a narrow strobe that clocks
* the bit registers once per decision, and cck = go & !done0 & !vd6

* the outputs are precharged again (valid low -> vd6 low).

XV1 vd1 valid vdd vss inv_a
XV2 vd2 vd1 vdd vss inv_a
XV3 vd3 vd2 vdd vss inv_a
XV4 vd4 vd3 vdd vss inv_a
XV5 vd5 vd4 vdd vss inv_a
XV6 vd6 vd5 vdd vss inv_a
XV7 vd7 vd6 vdd vss inv_a
XNV6 nvd6 vd6 vdd vss inv_a
XNV7 nvd7 vd7 vdd vss inv_a
XCP cp0 vd4 nvd7 vdd vss and2_a
XCPB cp1 cp0 vdd vss inv_c
XCPC cp cp1 vdd vss inv_d
XND0 ndone0 done0 vdd vss inv_a
XA3 n3 go ndone0 nvd6 vdd vss nand3_a
XCCK cck n3 vdd vss inv_c
XCCKB cckb cck vdd vss inv_c

XK5 clk5 act5 cp vdd vss and2_a

taskTitle: Design a 6-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 6-bit fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC, 100 MS/s, Sky130 TT.
* Architecture:
*  - Bootstrapped NMOS top-plate sampling switches (constant Vgs -> linear Ron).
*  - Differential binary-weighted CDAC, unit cap 21fF, 64u/side incl. dummy.
*  - Bottom plates share a floating node during track: self-biased at VDD/2
*    by charge conservation (no VCM reference needed).
*  - Bit j decision: bj=1 -> p-side bottom to vrefn, n-side to vrefp (-Sj);
*    bj=0 -> opposite (+Sj). Differential step immune to bottom-CM error.
*  - StrongARM comparator + asynchronous SAR handshake, registered outputs.
*
* ---------------- gate primitives ----------------
.subckt inv1 a y vdd vss
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends inv1
